GOV-F-003-S138.title: TTL Expiration and Recovery Logic
GOV-F-003-S138.description: Implement core logic to detect expired locks based on ttl_expiry and safely reassign ownership. Ensure atomic compare-and-swap semantics to prevent race conditions during recovery.

GOV-F-003-S139.title: Heartbeat Enforcement and TTL Renewal Rules
GOV-F-003-S139.description: Implement validation logic for heartbeat updates including ownership verification, TTL extension rules, and rejection of stale or invalid heartbeats.

GOV-F-003-S140.title: Concurrent Lock Conflict Resolution
GOV-F-003-S140.description: Handle concurrent lock acquisition attempts with deterministic conflict resolution, ensuring only one owner is granted the lock and others receive consistent failure responses.

GOV-F-003-S141.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Lock Lifecycle
GOV-F-003-S141.description: Create comprehensive tests covering acquire, heartbeat, expiration, recovery, and conflict scenarios including simulated concurrent access and failure recovery.
